section_summary.extract_value: This section details the character strengths measures used, specifically the 6-item Gratitude Questionnaire (GQ-6) and the 18-item Heartland Forgiveness Scale (HFS). It describes the GQ-6 as measuring a general tendency to feel grateful, with responses on a 7-point scale, and notes its excellent reliability in prior studies. The HFS is described as measuring dispositional forgiveness, comprising three subscales: Forgiveness of Self, Forgiveness of Others, and Forgiveness of Situations, also using a 7-point response scale.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section text describes the GQ-6 and HFS scales, their items, response formats, and reliability.
